lemmas.name: digit8_iff
lemmas.statement: ∀ (absN : Nat), (∃ i : Nat, absN / (10 ^ i) % 10 = 8) ↔ (List.range (absN + 1)).any (fun i => decide (absN / (10 ^ i) % 10 = 8)) = true
lemmas.proof:
by intro absN
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
    rw [List.any_eq_true]
    refine ⟨i, List.mem_range.mpr ?_, by simpa using hi⟩
    by_contra hge
    have h1 : i < 10 ^ i := Nat.lt_pow_self (by omega)
    have h2 : absN / 10 ^ i = 0 := Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by omega)
    rw [h2] at hi; simp at hi
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨i, _, hx⟩ := List.any_eq_true.mp h
    exact ⟨i, by simpa using hx⟩

lemmas.name: eight_ok
lemmas.statement: ∀ (n : Int) (h : isItEight_precond n), isItEight_postcond n ((n % 8 == 0) || (List.range (n.natAbs + 1)).any (fun i => n.natAbs / (10 ^ i) % 10 == 8)) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro n h
  unfold isItEight_postcond
  intro absN
  have hd := digit8_iff absN
  simp only [beq_iff_eq, Bool.or_eq_true] at hd ⊢
  simp only [beq_eq_decide] at hd ⊢
  rw [← hd]
